name: AB500 libraries
description: JavaScript libraries used by the first 500 Art Blocks Curated projects, stored on ABX FS as one gzip directory and published as project #0 "AB500 libraries" in the Art Blocks org.

storage.gzip: Node zlib.gzipSync defaults (what the CLI stores)

chains.name: Ethereum Sepolia
chains.gasSchedule: EIP-8037 (Glamsterdam): state creation repriced, so each full chunk is its own transaction

org.name: Art Blocks
